discrepancies.replication: Gene medians, top5/bottom3: C1HT_medium (4630/27836) > C1HT_small (3682/19451) > QUARTZseq2 (3616/9298) > 10X_8x10K_25K (2319/3044) > SMARTseq2 (2116/54192) > ... > inDrop (596/908) > Dropseq (568/991) > MARSseq (531/845)
discrepancies.note: Top tier agrees (plate-based + Smart-seq2 lead). Composite here still ranks Smart-seq2 #1 on non-UMI read depth (artefact); 10X_8x10K_25K sinks on shallow depth + low stability (0.58). Paper depth-equalises to 20K reads/cell.

discrepancies.paper: 20,000 reads/cell (lowest first quartile) + stepwise 25/50/75% via zUMIs; cells below threshold omitted
discrepancies.replication: Not performed; equal cell numbers only (1451/protocol)
discrepancies.note: Paper Fig. 2d-f library complexity is depth-controlled; our medians conflate depth with capture efficiency. Smart-seq2 read counts are not UMI-comparable.

discrepancies.paper: FACS viability sorting + QC on mapped counts with gene symbols
discrepancies.note: Artefact: GEO matrices use ENSEMBL IDs (ENSG...), so MT-/MT. prefix match finds nothing. Mito filter effectively disabled; min_genes>=200 is the only QC.

discrepancies.paper: Seurat graph clustering (8 PCs, res 0.6) + matchSCore2 labels (p>=0.5); avg projection agreement 80% (Quartz-Seq2 92%, gmcSCRB-seq 58%)
discrepancies.replication: Louvain on 30 PCs/k=15/res=1.0; species-level labels (coverage 1.0: Human/Mouse/Doublet/Dog); ARI 0.00-0.25 by construction; subsample stability 0.64-0.94 (mean ARI, 5 repeats)
discrepancies.note: Species labels stand in for cell types, so ARI indexes species agreement, not cell-type accuracy (R24 high-precision/low-accuracy quadrant expected). Stability is a precision proxy.

discrepancies.paper: PBMC 60% / colon 30% / HEK293T 6% / NIH3T3 3% / MDCK 1%; Chromium reference 30,807 human + 19,749 mouse cells
discrepancies.replication: All 15 human SubSeries (QC-pass 15/15, equalised to 1451) + parallel 15-protocol mouse track (equalised to 1154)
discrepancies.note: Species doublets retained; no Chromium reference or matchSCore2 projection. Paper Fig. 6 ranks shown on mouse views are human-derived.

discrepancies.paper: Joint human-mouse-dog mapping per protocol; species mix reported per protocol (Fig. 1)
discrepancies.replication: GSE141469 ships split matrices (human/mouse exp_mat); 10X_V3 composition is single-species by construction (Human 1.0 / Mouse 1.0)
discrepancies.note: Verified in data/metadata*.csv protocol x label crosstabs. 10X_V3 species shares (R25) and cross-species points (R29/R30) are not comparable with the other 14 jointly-mapped protocols.

similarity.qc_note: means over cells with >=200 genes (mito gate skipped: ENSEMBL IDs)

depths.note: median genes at thinned UMI depth (binomial, seed 0, <=60 QC cells/protocol)

joint.note: joint log1p-CP10K HVG PCA, <=100 QC cells/protocol, seed 0

mixability.note: kBET-style chi2 neighbourhood test (k=25, alpha=0.05); low = well mixed
